records.title: Leveraging historical information to boost retrieval-augmented generation in conversations

records.abstract_evidence_excerpt: To effectively manage and utilize the information in conversations, we explore the feasibility of boosting response generation by leveraging historical information and propose several strategies to incorporate this information individually or in combination.
